name: document_f3c_public_wearing_channel_order_sensitivity_v1
source: Reuse the parent's six same-user training domains and frozen source/target native trial identities. F0v2 remains in native channel order; only F3c cyclic-index adjacency changes. Fit the same scaler and balanced logistic classifier on source trials for each order, then score target trials.
permutations: Identity plus 12 deterministic eight-channel orders from different rotation/reflection equivalence classes, excluding the identity class; seed 20261002. The same order is applied to each user's source and target F3c input.
validation: Users 15-17; compare identity's pooled macro F1 and log loss ranks against the 12 counterfactual orders. No model/order is selected from the random controls.
descriptive_final: Users 18-20 were previously examined and are descriptive only.
boundary: This is a post-hoc order-sensitivity/falsification diagnostic, not a physical electrode mapping, permutation significance test, independent cohort or model-selection exercise. Nonphysical permutations deliberately use the same cyclic-index statistic as a counterfactual; they must never be treated as topology-attested deployment inputs.
